description: This Java class implements a service engine that invokes static Java methods based on service definitions, handling reflection and exceptions.

classes.name: StandardJavaEngine
classes.description: A final class extending GenericAsyncEngine that executes Java static methods as services.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and ignores the result.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously and returns the result map.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Uses reflection to invoke a static Java method specified by the service's location and invoke attributes.
